name: @pipeworx/mcp-amplitude

tools.name: amp_get_events
tools.description: Get event counts and breakdowns for a date range (e.g., "2024-01-01" to "2024-01-31"). Returns frequency, user segments, and trends by event name.

event_type.description: EXACT event name as registered in the Amplitude project (case-sensitive). Do NOT guess or invent names — use the user-provided event name verbatim. Amplitude rejects unknown events with a 400.

tools.name: amp_get_active_users
tools.description: Get active user counts by granularity (daily, weekly, or monthly) for a date range. Returns totals and trend data.

tools.name: amp_get_retention
tools.description: Get user retention metrics for a cohort over time. Returns retention percentages by time period (e.g., day 1, day 7, day 30).

tools.name: amp_user_search
tools.description: Search for users by ID or property (e.g., email, user_id). Returns matching profiles with properties, event history, and segments.

user.description: User search term (email, user_id, or Amplitude ID)

tools.name: amp_get_user_activity
tools.description: Get recent event activity timeline for a specific user. Returns events with timestamps, properties, and interactions.

amplitude_id.description: Amplitude internal user ID (from amp_user_search results)

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-amplitude forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the amplitude pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
